situation: Got a DM from Ben at a coffee subscription brand, Ridgeline, saying 'love your content, want to collab?' That's it. I have 45k on Instagram and I've actually been drinking their Ethiopia roast for months.
reply: Hi Ben, thanks for reaching out, I've actually been drinking your Ethiopia roast for months. To put together a proper proposal, could you share what deliverables you have in mind (reel, stories, feed post), the timeline, whether there's paid usage or exclusivity involved, and the budget range? Once I have that I'll come back within a day.
note: Genuine liking is mentioned once; no enthusiasm is spent before the terms are known.

situation: A Rafa, de uma marca de biquínis, me mandou DM oferecendo 3 peças em troca de um reels e 3 stories. Tenho 22 mil seguidores, curti a coleção nova deles, mas não faço permuta. Meu valor para um reels com 30 dias de uso orgânico começa em R$ 1.500.
reply: Oi, Rafa! Obrigada pelo convite, curti muito a coleção nova de vocês. Não faço conteúdo em troca de produto, porque o trabalho é o mesmo de qualquer jeito, mas topo conversar sobre um reels pago se couber no orçamento. Meu valor para um reels com 30 dias de uso orgânico começa em R$ 1.500. Se não der agora, boa sorte no lançamento!

situation: 一个国产护肤品牌找我做小红书笔记，预算2000，但要求永久授权还能投流。我平时单篇出镜图文报价3000，不出镜的纯产品图文是2000，都含30天授权；投流或更长授权一般按内容费的30%每90天另计。
reply: 谢谢你们直接说预算。2000的话，我可以做一篇不出镜的纯产品图文笔记，含30天自然流量授权，不含投流。如果需要投流或更长的授权，一般按内容费的30%每90天另计。你们大概打算投多久？我按实际需要给一个最简单的方案。
note: 授权和投流是钱藏着的地方：保住底价，用缩小交付范围来匹配预算。

situation: I'm a fitness creator on TikTok, 120k followers, a lot of them 16 to 20. A sports betting app, BetBlitz, offered $2,500 for one video. Their contact is Jordan. Easy money but not right for my audience.
reply: Hi Jordan, thanks for the offer. Sports betting isn't a fit for my audience, so I'm going to pass on this one. Wishing you a good campaign.
note: Decline mismatches fast, with no lecture about their product and no counteroffer; brands talk, and a clean no protects your reputation.

situation: I sent a quote to a kitchenware brand, Oakfield, on Sept 24: $900 for one TikTok featuring their cast iron pan, with 30 days of organic usage. The contact, Priya, went quiet. It's been 8 days. Worth one follow-up? A story set of three would be my smaller option.
reply: Hi Priya, just following up on the proposal I sent on 24 September for the Oakfield cast iron video. If the budget or timing has shifted, tell me and I'm happy to suggest a smaller option, like a story set of three. If it's not going ahead, no problem at all, and I'd be glad to hear from you for a future campaign.
note: One follow-up after a week, with an easy smaller option and an easy no. If this gets silence too, treat it as a no and move on.

situation: 和一个露营装备品牌谈好了：一条抖音视频加三篇小红书图文，10月15号到25号之间发，总价8000元，先付一半，含30天授权，不排他。对接人是小林，想发条消息把条款确认下来。
reply: 小林你好，确认一下我们谈好的内容：一条抖音视频加三篇小红书图文，10月15日到25日之间发布，总价8000元，签约后预付50%，交付后付剩余50%，含30天授权，不排他。今天我会把预付款的发票和内容脚本发你，脚本确认后就开始拍。如果哪一项和你的理解不一样，直接告诉我。
note: 条款、付款方式和授权范围都落在文字里再开工，确认消息本身就是合同的草稿。

situation: A protein bar brand, Fuelwell, offered $1,200 for one YouTube integration on my running channel (80k subs). Their contract, from Nina, asks for 6 months of category exclusivity covering all nutrition brands. I have an ongoing paid nutrition partnership, so I'd offer 60 days on protein bars and snacks within the $1,200, or six months on that category for $1,800.
reply: Hi Nina, thanks for sending the contract, the integration itself looks great. The one sticking point is exclusivity: I have an ongoing nutrition partnership, so six months across all nutrition brands isn't possible for me. Two options: 60 days of exclusivity on protein bars and snacks, included at $1,200, or six months on protein bars and snacks for $1,800. Which suits Fuelwell better?
note: Exclusivity is where the money hides: narrow the category, price the longer term, and keep existing partners out of it.

situation: Skincare brand Lumen paid $1,200 for one TikTok. They approved my script, I filmed it and did the one round of revisions in our contract on Sept 24. Now their manager Ellie wants a full reshoot with a different outfit and a new opening hook. I'd reshoot for $400 by Friday 9 October, or recut the existing footage with a new text hook for free by tomorrow.
reply: Hi Ellie, happy to help get this one right. Our contract included one round of revisions, which we used on 24 September, so a full reshoot sits outside the original scope. I can reshoot with the new outfit and hook for $400, delivered by Friday 9 October. If you'd rather stay within the current budget, I can recut the existing footage with a new text hook at no charge by tomorrow. Which would you prefer?
note: Scope creep after delivery: point to the brief once, price the extra work, and offer a free smaller fix so saying yes is easy either way.

situation: J'ai refusé une collab « contre produits » avec une marque de bougies et j'ai proposé une story payée à 250 euros. La responsable, Camille, m'a répondu : « D'autres créatrices le font gratuitement, vous savez. » J'ai 30 000 abonnés sur Instagram.
reply: Bonjour Camille, c'est tout à fait normal, et je comprends que ça marche pour certaines. Je ne suis simplement pas la bonne personne pour cette campagne. Bonne continuation pour le lancement, et si un budget se libère plus tard, je serai ravie d'en reparler.
note: Quand la marque se braque, on ne débat pas du marché : une ligne courtoise, la porte reste ouverte, et on passe à autre chose.

situation: An agency, Brightloop, emailed asking my rate for 3 UGC videos they'd run as ads for a meal-kit brand, nothing posted on my own account. Their contact Marcus won't share a budget and just says 'send your rates'. I charge $450 per UGC video with one revision and 30 days of paid-ad usage, $200 per video per extra 30 days, and ads run through my handle cost extra.
reply: Hi Marcus, thanks for the details. My rate is $450 per UGC video, so $1,350 for three, with one round of revisions each. That includes 30 days of paid-ad usage; each extra 30 days is $200 per video, and running ads through my handle is priced separately. If you tell me how long the ads will run, I'll send one clean package price today.
note: With UGC the money is in paid usage, so the quote separates the content fee from the usage window instead of giving one lump number.

situation: 一个坚果品牌找我在小红书发一篇测评，给1500元，但要求不走蒲公英平台、私下转账，笔记里也不要标注合作，说“写成自己买的更真实”。我有3万粉，他们家的坚果我自己确实常吃；走蒲公英的话1500元含30天授权我可以接。
reply: 谢谢邀请，你们家的坚果我自己确实常吃。合作的内容我都会标注，这一点没法调整：粉丝是因为信任才看我的推荐，小红书对商业合作怎么标注也有自己的规则，走蒲公英下单就能按规则来。如果走蒲公英下单，一篇图文笔记1500元我可以接，含30天授权，内容照样按我平时的风格写真实感受。你看这样可以吗？不方便的话也理解，祝新品大卖。
note: 只拒绝“不标注广告”这一点，不说教；标注要求以平台当前规则和当地的广告披露规定为准，给出合规的做法和原价，让对方选。

situation: A luggage brand, Voyant, agreed $2,000 for one YouTube integration on my 60k travel channel. The contract from Alex in partnerships says payment net 90 after the video goes live, nothing upfront. I normally take 50% upfront and the rest within 30 days; my fallback would be the full $2,000 within 30 days of publishing, no deposit.
reply: Hi Alex, thanks for sending the contract, the deliverables and usage all look good. The one change I need is the payment terms: with new partners I work with 50% on signing and 50% within 30 days of the video going live. If net 90 is fixed on your side, I could instead do the full $2,000 within 30 days of publishing, with no deposit. Which is easier for your finance team?
note: Payment terms are part of the rate: name your standard, offer one fallback, and don't start filming until the signed contract reflects it.

situation: A candle brand, Hearth & Co, paid me $600 per reel for three reels last autumn. Their contact Marisa wants to rebook for the holidays. I've grown from 40k to 95k followers since then and my reel rate is now $1,100 with 30 days of organic usage; as a returning partner I'd do three for $3,000.
reply: Hi Marisa, so good to hear from you again, and thanks for thinking of me for the holidays. Since we last worked together my audience has grown from 40k to 95k, so my reel rate is now $1,100 with 30 days of organic usage. As a returning partner, I can do three reels for $3,000. Could you share the timeline and whether you'd want any paid usage?
note: A rebooking is the natural moment to reset your rate: give the reason in one number and a small loyalty package, not last year's price.

situation: 我在抖音做家居收纳，5万粉丝。一个收纳盒品牌找我挂小黄车带货，只给20%佣金，不给坑位费，还要求至少发两条视频。我两条视频的报价一般是坑位费4000元加15%佣金，含30天授权；想试水的话可以先做一条，2000元加15%佣金。
reply: 谢谢邀请。纯佣金的合作我一般不接，因为拍视频的工作量是一样的，卖得怎么样还取决于价格和活动力度。两条视频我的报价是坑位费4000元加15%佣金，含30天自然流量授权。如果想先试试，也可以先做一条，2000元加15%佣金，看完数据再定第二条。你看哪种合适？
note: 纯佣金等于让创作者承担全部风险：说明原因，给保底加佣金的方案，再给一个更小的起步选项。

situation: Skincare brand Veracalm is paying me $1,500 for a reel about their new balm, and I'm due to film on Monday. The script from their contact, Theo, has me say 'it cleared my eczema in 7 days', but I don't have eczema and I've only used it for a week on dry patches.
reply: Hi Theo, thanks for the script, the balm has been lovely on my dry patches this week. The one line I can't say is 'it cleared my eczema in 7 days': I don't have eczema, and it's a medical claim I can't back up. I'd suggest: 'A week in, the dry patches on my hands feel soft again.' Everything else in the script works for me. Could you confirm the change by Friday so I can film on Monday?
note: Refuse the false claim, not the deal, and offer honest wording from your real use. Health claims in ads can carry rules, so check with the brand's compliance team if they push back.

situation: Uma marca de café, a Serra Alta, cancelou a campanha depois que eu já tinha gravado o reels. Recebi 50% adiantado (R$ 1.200 de R$ 2.400) e agora a Bia, do marketing, pediu o sinal de volta. A cláusula 6 do contrato diz que o sinal não é reembolsável depois do início da gravação; posso publicar o vídeo até 15 de dezembro pelos R$ 1.200 restantes.
reply: Oi, Bia, obrigada por avisar logo, entendo que os planos mudaram. Como o reels já foi gravado, o sinal de R$ 1.200 fica comigo, conforme a cláusula 6 do contrato. Se quiserem aproveitar o vídeo mais para frente, posso publicar até 15 de dezembro pelos R$ 1.200 restantes, sem gravar de novo. Me diz se isso faz sentido para vocês.
note: Cancelamento depois do trabalho feito: cite a cláusula uma vez, sem drama, e ofereça um jeito de a marca ainda aproveitar o que já pagou.

situation: Eine Outdoor-Marke, Gipfelwerk, lädt mich zu ihrem Launch-Event in München am Samstag, 17. Oktober, ein: vier Stunden vor Ort plus drei Instagram-Stories. Sie zahlen nur Anreise und Hotel, kein Honorar. Ich habe 35.000 Follower, nehme für drei Stories 350 Euro und für Präsenz-Events 500 Euro; die Ansprechpartnerin heißt Lena.
reply: Hallo Lena, danke für die Einladung, der Launch in München klingt richtig gut. Anreise und Hotel sind ein netter Rahmen, aber kein Honorar: Für vier Stunden vor Ort berechne ich 500 Euro und für ein Set aus drei Stories 350 Euro, zusammen also 850 Euro, plus Anreise und Hotel wie von euch angeboten. Wenn das in euer Budget passt, schick mir gern den Ablauf und sag mir, ob ihr die Stories auch auf euren eigenen Kanälen nutzen wollt. Dann melde ich mich innerhalb eines Tages zurück.
note: Reisekosten sind Auslagen, kein Honorar: Präsenz und Content getrennt bepreisen und die Nutzungsrechte gleich mit abfragen.

situation: An outdoor gear brand, Northpine, wants me as an ambassador for three months: one reel and one story set of three every month, for $700 a month. My rates are $900 per reel and $350 per story set, with 30 days of organic usage, and I'd do $1,050 a month for a three-month deal. The contact is Grace and she hasn't mentioned exclusivity.
reply: Hi Grace, thanks for thinking of me, I'd genuinely enjoy a longer run with Northpine. At my standard rates, a reel plus a story set is $1,250 a month; for a three-month commitment I can do $1,050 a month, $3,150 in total, with 30 days of organic usage on each piece. If $700 a month is the ceiling, two story sets a month fit that budget exactly. Could you also confirm whether the ambassador role comes with any exclusivity?
note: A long-term deal earns a modest package rate, not your per-post rate cut in half; and always ask about exclusivity before you sign.

situation: I review budget tech on YouTube, 140k subscribers. Earbud brand Sonaro offered $2,000 for a dedicated video, and the contract from Kevin includes clause 11: I can't post anything negative about Sonaro products for 12 months. I'd happily do the video and let them check the script for factual accuracy, but my channel runs on honest reviews.
reply: Hi Kevin, thanks for sending the contract, the fee and deliverables look good. The one clause I can't sign is clause 11: my channel runs on honest reviews, so I can't agree to say nothing negative about Sonaro for 12 months. I'm happy for your team to check the script for factual accuracy before the video goes live. Could you send a version without clause 11 so I can sign this week?
note: Strike the one clause that costs your audience's trust, offer a reasonable substitute, and keep the deal. Have anyone you trust read the rest of the contract too.

situation: 我是抖音探店博主，8万粉。三个月前我自费去一家茶饮店拍了条视频，播放不错。现在他们品牌的小周私信说想把这条视频转到官方账号，还想剪进广告里投流。官方号转发并@我的话我不收费；投流授权我一般按内容费的30%每90天另计，我单条视频报价5000元。
reply: 小周你好，谢谢喜欢这条视频！官方账号直接转发并@我、不用于投流的话，没问题，直接转就好。如果要剪进广告投流，这部分按授权另计，每90天1500元。你们大概打算投多久？我按实际需要给你一个最简单的方案，确认后我们把授权范围写下来。
note: 已经发布的旧视频也有授权问题：转发和投流分开谈，钱在投流那部分，范围要落在文字里。

situation: Home fitness brand Coreline offered $1,000 for one TikTok, but only if it hits 50,000 views in 7 days; otherwise they'd pay $300. I have 70k followers and my last ten videos averaged 35,000 views. My flat rate is $900 per TikTok with 30 days of organic usage, and I'd be open to a $200 bonus on top if it passes their target. The contact is Sofia.
reply: Hi Sofia, thanks for the offer. I don't price on view guarantees, since reach depends on the algorithm as much as the content, but here are my numbers: my last ten videos averaged 35,000 views. My rate for one TikTok is $900 with 30 days of organic usage. If you'd like a performance element, I'm happy to add a $200 bonus if it passes 50,000 views in 7 days. Would that work for you?
note: The flat fee covers the work; any upside for performance sits on top, never in place of it.

situation: I post about my two rescue greyhounds on TikTok, 50k followers. Hannah from a dog treat brand, Tailwise, wants three detailed video concepts plus a 15-second test clip 'so the team can decide', with no budget or deliverables yet. My rate is $850 per TikTok with 30 days of organic usage; once a brief is agreed I'd share a short idea direction.
reply: Hi Hannah, thanks for reaching out, my two greyhounds would be very keen to help. I don't make test clips or full concepts before a brief is agreed, since that is the actual work, but once I know the deliverables, timeline and budget I'm happy to share a short idea direction. For reference, my rate starts at $850 per TikTok with 30 days of organic usage. What did you have in mind?
note: Spec work is gifting in disguise: decline the free part, keep the door open for the paid part.

situation: 我是小红书美食博主，6万粉，单篇图文报价5000元，含30天授权；档期一般提前两周约，48小时内交稿加收30%加急费。一个调味品牌的对接人小米今天下午找我，说新品明晚8点前就要发一篇测评，产品今晚送到，但brief还没给。
reply: 小米你好，谢谢想到我！明晚8点前发属于加急：我的档期一般提前两周约，48小时内交稿会加收30%，所以这篇图文是6500元，含30天授权。时间比较紧，麻烦今晚9点前把brief发我，我明天中午前给你初稿确认。如果发布时间能放到两周后，就按5000元正常排期。你看选哪种？
note: 加急是档期成本，在报价里单独说明；同时给一个不加价的正常排期，让对方自己选。

situation: My daughter Ella is 15 and has 30k followers on TikTok for her crochet videos. A yarn brand, Loopwell, DMed her directly offering $400 for one video; the contact is Sasha. I'm her mum, Karen Holt, I handle anything paid, and I want them to deal with me at karen.holt@example.com and put the deliverables, usage and payment terms in writing before Ella says yes.
reply: Hi Sasha, thanks for reaching out to Ella, she was really pleased. I'm her mum, Karen Holt, and as she's 15 I handle all of her paid partnerships, so could you send the details to me at karen.holt@example.com? To look at the $400 offer properly I'd need the deliverables, posting dates, any usage rights or exclusivity, and the payment terms in writing. Once I have those, Ella and I will come back to you within a couple of days.
note: Move the deal out of a teenager's DMs and into a parent's inbox; check the platform's rules on minors in paid content before signing anything.

situation: I write a weekly personal finance newsletter with 18k subscribers and a 52% open rate. Owen from a budgeting app, Pocketwise, emailed asking my price for a 'dedicated send' to my whole list, with copy written by their team. I don't do dedicated sends; I sell one sponsor slot at the top of a regular issue for $600, I write it myself from the brand's brief, and I always label it as sponsored.
reply: Hi Owen, thanks for reaching out. I don't do dedicated sends, since my readers subscribed for my writing, but I do run one sponsor slot at the top of a regular issue: $600, written by me in my own voice from your brief, with your link and a clear 'sponsored' label. Could you share the timing you have in mind, the key points you'd want covered, and whether you'd need any exclusivity? Once I have that I'll send you available dates within a day.
note: Offer the format you actually sell instead of the one they asked for; keeping the copy in your own voice is part of what they are paying for.

situation: 去年跟一个母婴品牌合作，说好交付后30天付款，结果拖了两个多月才到账。现在对接人阿琳又来约双十一的两条抖音视频，我单条报价3000元，含30天授权。我想接，但这次要全款预付才开拍。
reply: 阿琳你好，谢谢又想到我，双十一这波我也挺想做的。两条视频一共6000元，含30天授权。上次的尾款比约定晚了两个多月才到，所以这次我需要拍摄前全款预付，到账后马上排期。如果你们那边可以，我今天就把报价单发你。
note: 回头客有付款拖延的记录时，把付款条件改严，理由用一句事实说清，不翻旧账。

situation: 我是小红书穿搭博主，10万粉，单篇图文报价6000元，含30天授权。一个服装品牌的对接人小雅发来合同，第9条要求我授权他们永久使用我的肖像和声音，用来生成AI数字人广告，不另外付费。我愿意接这篇笔记，但不想把脸和声音永久交出去。
reply: 小雅你好，谢谢发合同过来，笔记的内容和报价都没问题。唯一需要改的是第9条：我的肖像和声音不授权用于生成AI数字人广告，也不做永久授权。这篇图文按6000元、含30天授权，照常可以做。麻烦发我一版删掉第9条的合同，我确认后这周就签。
note: 肖像和声音是比单条内容大得多的授权：只划掉这一条，保住这单合作；签之前可以请懂合同的人看一下其他条款。

situation: I have 25k followers on Instagram for my plant care videos. Someone called Mia, DMing from a brand-new account, offered $1,500 for three posts for a brand called Verdeluxe, but says I first need to pay a $79 'shipping and onboarding fee' for the sample kit, and she won't give a company email or a written contract. I want to reply without burning a bridge in case it's real.
reply: Hi Mia, thanks for thinking of me. I don't pay fees to take part in any campaign, so the $79 isn't something I'll do; on paid work, the brand covers samples and shipping. If Verdeluxe would like to go ahead, please send the brief, deliverables, timeline and a written contract from a company email address, and I'll come back to you within a day.
note: Paying to get paid is a common scam pattern: send no money or personal details, and report the account to the platform if it keeps pushing.

situation: I review kitchen gadgets on YouTube, 90k subscribers. Dana, partnerships lead at a blender brand, Kova, offered $1,800 for a sponsored video on the Kova 2, my usual rate with 30 days of organic usage, but says their team needs my YouTube login to upload it and manage comments. I upload my own videos and can send the final cut for approval 48 hours before it goes live.
reply: Hi Dana, thanks for reaching out, I'd be glad to put the Kova 2 through its paces, and $1,800 with 30 days of organic usage works for me. I don't share my channel login with anyone, so I'll upload the video myself. I'll send you the final cut to approve 48 hours before it goes live, so your team sees exactly what gets published. Shall I send you some dates?
note: Never hand over a login or a verification code, however real the brand looks; asking for them is a common account-takeover scam, so if they insist, stop and report the account to the platform.

situation: I post dog training tips on Instagram, 40k followers. Maya from a small local dog rescue, Second Chance Paws, asked if I'd make three reels for their adoption drive for free, since they have no budget. I love what they do and I'm happy to donate one reel and share their adoption posts in my stories through October, but three reels is about two days' work I can't give away.
reply: Hi Maya, thank you for asking, I love what Second Chance Paws does. Three reels is more than I can give for free, but I'd be glad to donate one reel for the adoption drive and share your adoption posts in my stories through October. If that helps, send me a short brief with the dogs you'd most like featured and your timing, and I'll come back to you within a day.
note: For a cause you believe in, decide what you'll give and offer it as a clear package, so the free work has edges.

situation: 料理系のYouTubeチャンネルで、登録者は約8万人、視聴者の約7割が25〜44歳の女性です。調味料メーカー「ひかり醸造」の田中さんから、依頼内容を決める前に視聴者層のデータと料金表がほしいと連絡があり、アナリティクス画面のスクリーンショットも出せます。タイアップ動画は1本25万円で30日間のオーガニック利用込み、広告での二次利用と競合排他は別料金です。
reply:
田中様
ご連絡いただきありがとうございます。チャンネル登録者は約8万人で、視聴者の約7割が25〜44歳の女性です。YouTubeアナリティクスの画面が必要でしたら、スクリーンショットでお送りします。タイアップ動画は1本25万円で、30日間のオーガニック利用を含みます。広告での二次利用や競合排他をご希望の場合は、別途お見積りいたします。本数、公開時期、ご予算の目安を教えていただければ、1日以内にご提案をお送りします。
note: データは数字で短く渡し、料金は利用範囲とセットで示して、相手の条件を聞き返す。

situation: Sunscreen brand Solene paid me $1,000 flat for one Instagram reel that went live on 15 September, and the contract has no view guarantee. Their contact, Rhea, says it got 12,000 views against my usual 30,000 and wants a second reel for free to make up for it. I'm happy to send the reel's full insights and add a free story set of three resharing it, labelled as a paid partnership like the reel, but a second reel would be my normal $1,000.
reply: Hi Rhea, thanks for being upfront about the numbers, and I understand 12,000 views is below what we both hoped for. Our contract was a flat fee with no view guarantee, so a free second reel isn't something I can do. What I can add at no extra cost is a story set of three resharing the reel, labelled as a paid partnership like the original, and I'll send you the reel's full insights today. If you'd like a second reel, it would be my usual $1,000. Would the story set help?
note: A post that underperforms is not a breach: point to the flat fee once, offer a small goodwill extra with the same disclosure, and price any new work.

situation: 我写一个家居改造的微信公众号，去年给一个灯具品牌报的是平均每篇阅读2万，今年改版后降到1.2万左右。现在他们的对接人小陈又来约稿，准备按去年的数字下单。我现在一篇软文报价6000元，是按1.2万的阅读定的，文章会标注“广告”，可以发近三个月的后台截图。
reply: 小陈你好，谢谢你们又想到我。先把数据说准：去年报给你们的平均2万是去年的水平，今年改版后平均每篇阅读在1.2万左右，近三个月的后台截图我今天发你。按现在的阅读，一篇软文6000元，文章会标注“广告”。你们看看这样还合适吗？
note: 数据下滑时主动说清，比被品牌自己查出来更能保住合作；报价跟着真实数字走，广告标注照常。

situation: I'm a running creator on YouTube with 70k subscribers, and I'm under a signed exclusivity for running footwear with another shoe brand until 31 December. Paolo from a shoe brand, Kestrel Run, emailed offering $2,200 for one video in November. I'd genuinely like to work with them from January, and my rate for a dedicated video is $2,200 with 30 days of organic usage.
reply: Hi Paolo, thanks for reaching out, and for a generous offer. I'm under an exclusivity agreement for running footwear until 31 December, so I can't take on a shoe video in November. From January I'd be glad to talk: my rate for a dedicated video is $2,200 with 30 days of organic usage. Shall I get in touch in early January, or would you rather come back to me when you plan your spring campaigns?
note: Say the exclusivity exists without naming the partner or its terms; check your contract for what you're allowed to disclose.

situation: I host a weekly gardening podcast, Dirt Under Nails, averaging 6,000 downloads per episode in the first 30 days. Dev from a seed company, Sproutbox, offered $400 for a 60-second host-read ad in four episodes. My rate is $150 per episode for a host-read mid-roll, so four would be $600; as a first test I'd do three episodes for $400, and I always open the read with 'this episode is sponsored by'.
reply: Hi Dev, thanks for reaching out, a seed company is a natural fit for our listeners. Dirt Under Nails averages 6,000 downloads per episode in the first 30 days, and my rate for a 60-second host-read mid-roll is $150 per episode, so four episodes would be $600. If $400 is the budget, I can do three episodes for $400 as a first test. Every read opens with 'this episode is sponsored by', so listeners always know. Could you share the timing and the key points you'd like covered?
note: Quote from your real per-episode numbers, match a tight budget with fewer episodes rather than a cut rate, and state how the sponsorship is disclosed.

situation: 我是B站数码区UP主，12万粉。和一个充电宝品牌的对接人小何谈好一条定制视频，8000元，含30天授权。今天他发来brief，最后补了一句要所有原始素材（未剪辑的源文件），方便他们自己剪广告。我的做法是：原始素材另加3000元，只能用在他们自己的渠道，授权90天；或者不给源文件，我免费多导出一版竖屏成片。
reply: 小何你好，brief收到了，内容方向没问题。原始素材需要单独说一下：未剪辑的源文件不包含在8000元的定制视频里。如果需要，原始素材另加3000元，只能用在你们自己的渠道，授权90天。如果主要是想要更多尺寸方便剪广告，我也可以免费多导出一版竖屏成片。你们看选哪种？确认后我们把范围写进合同。
note: 原始素材是比成片大得多的授权：单独定价、限定渠道和期限，再给一个不加钱的替代方案。

situation: I review e-bikes on YouTube, 60k subscribers. Last year I posted a critical review of Voltmile's V1 bike over battery problems, and now their marketing lead, Jade, is offering $2,500, my usual rate with 30 days of organic usage, for a sponsored video on the new V2, on condition that I take the V1 review down. I'd keep the V1 review up, but I'm happy to pin a comment on it linking to the V2 video and to let her team fact-check the script.
reply: Hi Jade, thanks for reaching out about the V2, and $2,500 with 30 days of organic usage works for me. The one condition I can't accept is taking down the V1 review: my channel runs on honest reviews, so it stays up. What I can do is pin a comment on it linking to the V2 video, so viewers find the new model, and your team is welcome to fact-check the script before it goes live. Would that work for you?
note: Refuse the condition, not the deal: an honest past review isn't something a sponsorship can buy, and the new video is labelled as sponsored like any other.
